activity_summary: At home you gave Susanna the gingerbread that had come back in a paper. Judith had carried it unopened. Hamnet had already eaten his pennyworth. Anne sent them to wash. Susanna kept the paper until the board was clear.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Gave her the paper and made no more of the market.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Sent them to wash, and left the unfolding to Susanna.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the paper and waited for the board.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Reported the paper carried, and not opened.

facets.activity: Gave Susanna the gingerbread in a paper

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: This came home in a paper, Susanna.

quotes.speaker: judith_shakespeare
quotes.text: I carried it and I did not open it.

quotes.speaker: susanna_shakespeare
quotes.text: A penny that survives the lane is a serious penny.
